correctness.rationale: For any three-leader allocation the follower Laplacian has two constant-fiber modes and scalar orthogonal modes, giving J_a exactly. Positive rational denominators and four exact difference identities resolve all \(p=2,3,4,5\) and \(p\ge6\) cases, including degenerate zero-follower blocks and all ties. The sign proof for \(p\ge6\) rewrites its numerator at \(q=p+k\) into three nonpositive coefficients with a strictly negative constant. Five symbolic identities and 1,876 independently formed exact matrix inversions reproduce the formula, but are not substitutes for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A budget of three directly sensing leaders on two interacting populations is a motivated placement optimization, not a contrived small graph. The theorem identifies every optimum for infinitely many complete bipartite networks, including a non-obvious allocation reversal at smaller-part size six and exact exceptional equality windows up to \((5,30)\), and quantifies all costs and counts. These are deployment decisions which are not determined by a generic optimizer existence theorem, a degree heuristic, or a finite table.
